title: Recurring dream about a school
content: I know it’s secondary school in my dream world, but it’s definitely not the one I went to. It always starts with me leaving a city scape on foot, as my younger self, through some foliage/tall grass/farm fields, sometimes with friends(?), ending up at the school building. It’s always a pale yellow brick building that is very long. The front doors open up to a small-ish square lobby that leads to either a gymnasium or a cafeteria. The left hand side (from the lobby) is a long hallway of windows and classroom doors. The right hand hallway leads to arts and recreational classrooms. At the end of each hall are emergency exits, and they wrap around the gym/cafeteria like a rectangle. If you turn the corner on either side all the way down the hall, you’ll get to a set of stairs going up to more classrooms. Pretty damn mundane. Aside from the anxiety of realizing I’m not sure where I need to go (usually), the thing that gets me is that there is always *something* that makes everyone evacuate the building. It always turns to dust by the end of the dream. What is it with this school I’ve never seen before that I always visit in my dreams that always falls apart?? Does anyone else have something similar??? I’d like to add before I post: I found this sub and some of the images have been startlingly familiar, but I’ve never seen this, and I’m not much of an artist lol. Thanks!
